yt.title: Poland's economy was 66% of Sweden's in 2000. Now? #Shorts
yt.description:
GDP in current US dollars, Poland as a share of Sweden, 2000 vs 2025. Source: World Bank (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD). Exchange rates affect this comparison.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Sweden has long been one of the richest countries in Europe. Here is how Poland's economy compares, and how that changed.
In 2000, Poland's economy was sixty-six percent the size of Sweden's. By 2025, it was one hundred and fifty-five percent.
Poland also has far more people, so per person the picture is very different. Total size is not the same as wealth. What would you compare next?
